name: C P S Shapers Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2012, C P S Shapers Ltd manufactures and sells compressed garments[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
CPS Shapers Limited, operating under the brand Dermawear, is India’s first R&D-led shapewear and innerwear manufacturer for both men and women. The brand focuses on designing products suited to Indian body types, climate, and attire. Dermawear has sold over 1 crore units across 3,000 SKUs and has a strong retail presence in over 6,000 outlets nationwide.

cons: Stock is trading at 14.2 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Debtor days have increased from 43.1 to 68.0 days.
Working capital days have increased from 85.9 days to 148 days
